text:
olivia: Quick q — we merged a deps-only bump (protobuf 3.9.1 -> 3.9.2) in #4127. Do we need to bump patch and publish release notes? deploy-bot already created an RC.
release-bot: :robot_face: created release candidate v1.12.4-rc1 for branch main (changes: deps-only). See CI artifacts.
raj: If it's strictly dev tooling (scripts, ci, lint) then we usually skip a public patch. If any runtime transitive changed (protobuf runtime ABI) we should bump.
alex: Our informal rule historically: bump patch for any runtime-impact or user-facing change, otherwise group into next scheduled patch window. But that's fuzzy.
maya: Ops asks that any semver bump (even patch) follow tagging convention and include a small release note — dedicated customers parse notes.
sam: Can release-bot do heuristics? e.g., if files changed only under /tools /ci /docs -> auto-suggest skip; else flag for release-council.
release-council: Prefer an explicit opt-in for skipping. We've had cases where a skipped bump caused backport confusions. Suggest release-bot create candidate but add a 'skip-suggested' label with rationale and require ACK from release-council or /release-bot ack-skip.
olivia: Sounds reasonable. Also, how do we annotate the changelog when skipped? We shouldn't fabricate notes, but ops wants a stub.
raj: Keep semver strict: don't invent pre-release suffixes for deps (no v1.12.4-deps). Use conventional commits or labels. release-bot should look for 'release:skip' label or commit message containing '[no-release]'.
alex: Proposed workflow:
1) PR merged -> release-bot inspects changed paths and commit messages.
2) If heuristic deems deps-only, release-bot creates RC but posts: "skip suggested: deps-only (files: vendor/, go.mod, yarn.lock)".
3) Release-council can /release-bot ack-skip to cancel the release, or /release-bot release to force.

Example release-bot comment:
```
release-bot: Detected deps-only changes. Suggest skipping patch release.
Reason: only package-lock/yarn.lock and tooling changes detected.
Commands:
  /release-bot ack-skip   # mark as reviewed, do NOT publish
  /release-bot release    # force publish patch
  /release-bot hold       # pause until manual review
```
maya: For changelog, if skipped, add a single-line stub automatically: "deps: bump protobuf 3.9.1 -> 3.9.2 (no runtime impact asserted)". That helps tracking without implying a release.
sam: Also please include a rollback pointer in any patch release message: link to docs/release/rollback.md and the quick rollback commands. If someone accidentally publishes, we need playbook.
release-bot: :white_check_mark: Skip suggested for v1.12.4-rc1 (reason: deps-only). Awaiting ACK from release-council or use /release-bot release to force.
release-council: ack-skip (we'll rely on the changelog stub and backport if needed).
